messages:
Maya CSM: Heads-up — Quiet pattern on NovusRetail the last 3 weeks. Daily API calls down ~68% vs baseline. Saw an inbound from procurement asking for cost breakdowns.
Jordan AE: Oh no. Did we lose the internal champion?
Maya CSM: New PM, Sara, joined mid-February. I pinged her but only got an automated OOO. Procurement contact (Lena) asked for unit economics and a demo for the credit team.
Jordan AE: Competitor pilot launched last week in EMEA from what I heard. Any feature gaps they called out?
Maya CSM: They noted latency spikes at high concurrency and missing reranking support for a specific pipeline. We do have reranking but might need a short demo to show reliability + SLOs.
Ravi Support: Checked logs — a spike in 2xx-but-slow responses around 2026-02-22 during their peak batch. No errors, just queuing. We raised temporary batch limit last month.
Tom Eng: That queuing was the autoscaler reacting to a misconfigured min-replicas in their Dedicated pool. We patched it on 2/23. Historical qps now looks fine.
Maya CSM: Good to know. Lena (procurement) is asking for a timeline on guarantees and a reusable appendix for security/compliance. Wants a finance-facing cost deck too.
Lena Finance: I can do a one-pager on committed vs burst pricing and show a 12-month forecast with blended unit cost. Need current usage trends + peak headroom numbers.
Maya CSM: Attached quick query I ran: `SELECT day, api_calls FROM usage WHERE account='novusretail' ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30;` shows the drop. Sharing graph in #customer-dash later.
Jordan AE: Proposed next steps: 1) 30-min sync with Sara + procurement this week (Maya/Jordan/Lena). 2) Engineering QoS note + short demo to prove reranking latency. 3) Offer a 3-month bridge pricing/BURST credit while they evaluate. Thoughts?
Tom Eng: Happy to do a 15-min tech walkthrough and surface the autoscaler fix + SLA notes. I can record a 5-min clip showing end-to-end rerank flow and latency numbers.
Ravi Support: I'll compile a timeline of the slow window, what we changed, and the mitigation steps. Can include runbook excerpt.
Lena Finance: Bridge credit sounds reasonable for a pilot. Can we limit it to specific endpoints and a spend cap? Prefer that over blanket discounts.
Maya CSM: Yep — suggest cap + explicit endpoints. Also recommend an enablement session for their ML engs on efficient batching and prefix caching to reduce cost.
Jordan AE: I'll offer the demo and bridge credit formally in the next email. Maya — can you set the 30-min with Sara and CC Lena & Tom?
Maya CSM: On it. Proposed times sent. Also adding a short customer survey to capture why they spun up competitor pilot (two quick Qs).
ops-bot: Meeting created: NovusRetail — Renewal check-in — 2026-03-23 14:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent to: Sara, Lena, Maya CSM, Jordan AE, Tom Eng.
Jordan AE: Great. Action items: Maya = send pre-read (usage + cost one-pager) by EOD tomorrow; Tom = 5-min demo clip; Ravi = mitigation timeline; Lena = bridge credit terms draft.
Maya CSM: Noted. Will also include suggested A/B rollout for reranker test in the pre-read to show low-risk validation path.
Ravi Support: If the procurement team requests a test SLA, we should prepare a short statement of historical p95/mean token latency and error rates for the last quarter. I can pull that.
Maya CSM: Thanks team — aiming to turn this into a pilot save, not a renewal fight. Will post updates after the sync. :thumbsup:
